description: A token's USD candles (open, high, low, close, USD volume, trades), oldest first, the latest 32 by default. Use from and to (Unix seconds) for a past range.

address.description: Token contract address (0x and 40 hex digits, any case)

from.description: Range start in Unix seconds, inclusive

to.description: Range end in Unix seconds (default now)

name: get_token_candles
title: Get a token's USD candles
